items.caption: Ceci n'est pas une femme — campaign poster
items.details: Campaign poster for Collectif Aswat, carrying the statement “hadi mashi mra / ceci n’est pas une femme” (this is not a woman) in Arabic and French, over a punching bag wrapped in calligraphy.

items.caption: Abolissez l'article 222 — campaign poster
items.details: Campaign poster calling for the abolition of Article 222 of the Moroccan penal code, which punishes publicly breaking the Ramadan fast with prison and a fine. A tagine served on a toilet, with the hashtag #MangerNestPasUnCrime (eating is not a crime).

items.caption: Balacona hip hop night — event poster
items.details: Poster for Balacona's hip hop night in Amsterdam (30/07/2022): Mehdi Black Wind with Lyllice, Kourosh, Kruloh, Enana and OTAT, with DJs Mamakil and Retro Casetta. Supported by Waraqlab and the Arab Fund for Arts and Culture.

items.caption: Body series — collage
items.details: Art-direction collage from a series on the body: Arabic calligraphy layered over a duotone male torso on deep blue.

items.caption: Submerged — collage
items.details: Art-direction collage: a submerged figure in teal duotone, part of a series on the body.

items.caption: Silenced strings — collage
items.details: Art-direction collage: a violinist portrait behind bars with Arabic typography in the background.

items.caption: Hands in motion — collage
items.details: Art-direction collage: cut-out arms and hands in black and white over peach and pink geometric circles.

items.caption: Masked — collage
items.details: Art-direction collage: a face assembled from pink protective masks, ringed by pointing hands on green — a pandemic-era piece.

items.caption: Men's engagement for gender equality — program poster
items.details: Arabic program poster (البرنامج) for the men's-engagement-for-gender-equality roundtable, ONU Femmes.

items.caption: Ftour-débat — roundtable poster
items.details: Arabic breakfast-debate poster: 'أي انخراط للرجال من أجل المساواة بين الجنسين؟' (What engagement of men for gender equality?), UN Women / ONU Femmes, 13 June 2017, Ibis Hotel Agdal, Rabat.

items.caption: Table ronde — programme poster
items.details: French program poster for the debate 'Quel engagement pour les hommes dans l'égalité de genre?', with certificate ceremony and musical closing.

items.caption: Quel engagement des hommes — ftour-débat poster
items.details: French 'FTOUR-DÉBAT' poster with purple profile silhouettes: 'Quel engagement des hommes pour l'égalité de genre?', 13 June 2017, Hôtel Ibis Agdal-Rabat, ONU Femmes.

items.caption: Siyada Network — debt crisis study poster
items.details: Promo graphic for Siyada Network's December 2023 study on debt and food dependency in Egypt: 'أزمة الديون والتبعية الغذائية في مصر', with booklet and smartphone mockups.

items.caption: Emblem logo — identity
items.details: Maroon inverted-triangle emblem with an orange Arabic-calligraphy logo mark.

items.caption: Abstract logo — identity
items.details: Black monochrome logo: an anarchist-style 'A' crossed by an eye/fish-shaped ellipse with spiky extensions.

items.caption: Tanit — logo banner
items.details: Wide hand-drawn logo banner: Latin 'TANIT' and Arabic 'تانيت' beside a blue circle with three dark diamonds.

items.caption: Tarikhna Hna Archive — logo
items.details: 'TARIKHNA HNA ARCHIVE' logo: white card on black with Arabic 'أرشيف تاريخنا هنا', a Tifinagh-script line, and an orange circle with two gray diamonds.

items.caption: Love Is Not a Crime — poster
items.details: Red-square poster: white lettering where the 'o' in Love is a keyhole and the 'C' in Crime is a handcuff, over background words (Code pénal, Droits Humains, Liberté…).

items.caption: Ifkart — web design
items.details: Full-page homepage design for 'ifkart', a Moroccan culture/events portal: concert hero, event cards, newsletter signup, magazine cover.

items.caption: Kenzardi — web design
items.details: Homepage design for 'KENZARDI', a Moroccan terroir-products site: spice-market hero with product cards and prices.

items.caption: Le Dawliz Hôtel & Spa — brochure
items.details: Bilingual French–English spa price-list brochure: massages, hammams, hairdressing, skin treatments, prices in Dhs/€.

items.caption: Le Dawliz Hôtel & Spa — brochure cover
items.details: Brochure cover: 'Le Dawliz Hôtel & Spa — Le SPA Fitness · Hammams · Soins' over hot stones and a white orchid, Rabat/Salé.

items.caption: Into the void — illustration
items.details: Surreal minimalist illustration: a white figure falling legs-first into a black hole on deep blue with floating black ovals.

items.caption: Three hands — illustration
items.details: Three hands rising from blue, purple and orange rings on dark gray, each holding a small yellow flag with a purple circle.

items.caption: Afro and parrot — illustration
items.details: Colorful cartoon: a shirtless yellow-skinned man with a big white afro and a parrot on his head, holding up his pants, against green with Arabic-style calligraphy doodles.

items.caption: Boxing uterus — illustration
items.details: Orange uterus wearing white polka-dot boxing gloves attached to its fallopian tubes, on dark gray.

items.caption: Unzipped — illustration
items.details: A woman's face unzipping out of a black dual-profile silhouette mask on burnt orange: spiral eyes, bindi, nose ring, zipper down the center.

items.caption: Scream — illustration
items.details: Surreal cartoon: a giant red screaming mouth on teal blue, with four stretched orange fists streaming leftward.

items.caption: Release party — fundraiser poster
items.details: Event poster for a fundraiser for Open Closet LGBT Netherlands, 'THE HANG-OUT 070', December 21, Paviljoensgracht 2, Den Haag: colorful gradient blobs on a topographic-line background.
